reason: I have to buy a site anyway and document it, and this is the first offer that says the words my file uses: acceptance report, dated screenshots, invoice matching the contract, funding page in the programme format. He writes the texts from a phone call, which is the part I would never find an evening for.
objection: It is a template, he says so himself, so my guesthouse will look like every other LEADER site in the county; and he is one man doing this 10 hours a week beside a day job, so if he gets sick or busy my 10 days become 40 and my reporting deadline does not move. The 5-working-days silent acceptance also worries me, because I am exactly the person who does not answer emails for a week.
would_change_my_mind: If at the GAL info day next week they tell me I need three comparative offers and his is not the lowest, or that the invoice and acceptance report have to be in a different format than what he describes, I go with whoever the consultant points me to instead.
